title.narrative: UNICEF’s engagement this year has reaped key achievements in transparency, child-related spending advocacy and youth budgetary participation. The technical support to the MoF has contributed to the jump in the 2023 OBS scores putting Egypt 8th globally for participation and 2nd in MENA for transparency. Moreover, an expenditure monitoring model is designed for youth to engage in social accountability to enhance spending efficiency. On the adequacy of child-related spending, strong advocacy with the IFIs and stakeholders continues to ensure the protection of social sector allocation and protection of vulnerable children.
